jobDescription:
Inside Sales Representative (m/f/d) - Part-time 30 hours
Join our small team in Vienna and help us reach new customers by phone and email.
What you bring:
* Completed commercial apprenticeship or a comparable qualification
* Fluent German (native level) and good English
* Experience with a CRM system is preferred
* Availability Monday to Thursday from 9 am to 3 pm
What we offer: EUR 2,400 gross per month for 30 hours, plus bonus. Questions? Contact Lukas Berger.
